title: Causal Discovery in Equal Variance Linear Gaussian DAGs via SURE-Tuned Ridge Regression
abstract: arXiv:2608.17132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recovering the directed acyclic graph (DAG) of a structural equation model (SEM) from observational data is a central problem in causal discovery. The iterative gradient descent and per-problem hyperparameter tuning of continuous-optimization methods are poorly suited to two practically important regimes: the sample-limited regime, where the number of samples is comparable to or smaller than the number of nodes in the DAG, and the compute-limited regime. This work proposes SURE-Ridge, a non-iterative, closed-form estimator for equal variance linear Gaussian SEM. The method performs parallel node-wise regressions with regularization parameters chosen adaptively by Stein's unbiased risk estimate (SURE), and applies an adaptive thresholding procedure to extract a DAG from the resulting soft adjacency matrix. translated_title: 基于SURE调优岭回归的等方差线性高斯DAG因果发现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17132v1 公告类型：新 摘要：从观测数据中恢复结构方程模型（SEM）的有向无环图（DAG）是因果发现中的一个核心问题。连续优化方法的迭代梯度下降和逐问题超参数调整，不适合两种实际重要的场景：样本受限场景（样本数量与DAG节点数量相当或更少）和计算受限场景。本研究提出SURE-Ridge，一种用于等方差线性高斯SEM的非迭代、闭式估计器。该方法执行并行的节点级回归，通过Stein无偏风险估计（SURE）自适应选择正则化参数，并应用自适应阈值程序从所得的软邻接矩阵中提取DAG。数值结果表明，SURE-Ridge在小样本场景中实现了最低的结构汉明距离，并具有最低的运行时间。
tldr: 提出SURE-Ridge，一种基于SURE调优岭回归的非迭代闭式估计器，在小样本和计算受限条件下高效恢复等方差线性高斯DAG，显著降低结构误差和运行时间。
en_tdlr: SURE-Ridge, a non-iterative closed-form estimator using SURE-tuned ridge regression, efficiently recovers equal-variance linear Gaussian DAGs under small-sample and compute-limited settings, achieving lower structural error and runtime.
